label: URA Private Residential Property Price Index (all residential)
definition: Price index of private residential property transactions (landed and non-landed, completed and uncompleted), whole island, compiled by URA with a stratified hedonic regression since 2015-Q1.
update_frequency: Quarterly; flash estimate at quarter end, final figures about four weeks later

label: URA Private Residential Rental Index (non-landed, whole island)
definition: Rental index of non-landed private residential leases, whole island, compiled by URA from IRAS stamp-duty data on tenancy agreements.
update_frequency: Quarterly; flash estimate at quarter end, final figures about four weeks later

label: HDB Resale Price Index
definition: Resale price index of HDB flats, all flat types, by registration date, compiled with a stratified hedonic regression since 2014-Q4.
update_frequency: Quarterly; flash estimate at quarter end, final figures about four weeks later

label: 3-month compounded SORA
definition: Singapore Overnight Rate Average compounded over the preceding three months, end of month, the benchmark most Singapore floating-rate mortgages now reference.
update_frequency: Monthly; SingStat table refreshed about two weeks after month end

label: SGS 10-year bond yield
definition: Yield on the 10-year Singapore Government Securities benchmark bond, end of month (average of closing bid rates quoted by SGS primary dealers).
update_frequency: Monthly; SingStat table refreshed about two weeks after month end

label: Commercial banks' housing and bridging loans outstanding
definition: Outstanding housing and bridging loans extended by commercial banks to residents, end of month (consumer loans category, MAS Notice 610 basis).
update_frequency: Monthly; about four weeks after month end

label: Real GDP, seasonally adjusted (chained 2015 dollars)
definition: Gross domestic product in chained 2015 dollars, seasonally adjusted, expenditure approach.
update_frequency: Quarterly; advance estimate two weeks after quarter end, this table about six weeks after

label: Overall unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted
definition: Unemployed persons as a share of the labour force (residents and non-residents), end of quarter, seasonally adjusted with X-12-ARIMA.
update_frequency: Quarterly; advance estimate a month after quarter end, this table with the full labour market report about twelve weeks after

label: Consumer Price Index, all items
definition: All-items Consumer Price Index, 2024 = 100, not seasonally adjusted.
update_frequency: Monthly; about 23 days after month end

label: CPI accommodation component
definition: Accommodation component of the CPI (actual rentals and imputed rentals of owner-occupiers), 2024 = 100, not seasonally adjusted.
update_frequency: Monthly; about 23 days after month end

label: Private residential transactions, whole of Singapore
definition: Number of private residential units transacted in the quarter, summing new sales (completed and uncompleted), resales and sub-sales; excludes executive condominiums.
update_frequency: Quarterly; about four weeks after quarter end

label: Unsold private residential units with planning approvals
definition: Unsold private residential units with planning approval, end of quarter, summed over the three market segments and four completion/launch statuses (completed; launched; not yet launched; without pre-requisites).
update_frequency: Quarterly; about four weeks after quarter end

label: Private non-landed residential vacancy rate
definition: Vacant completed non-landed private residential units as a percentage of the available completed non-landed stock, end of quarter. Derived by this workflow from the two published unit counts.
update_frequency: Quarterly; about four weeks after quarter end

label: Private non-landed units under construction
definition: Non-landed private residential units under construction, end of quarter (excludes executive condominiums); the part of the pipeline that will complete within roughly three years.
update_frequency: Quarterly; about four weeks after quarter end

label: Non-resident population
definition: Foreigners working, studying or living in Singapore without permanent residence (excluding tourists and short-term visitors), as at end-June.
update_frequency: Annual; end-June estimate published in late September

label: Net rounds of property cooling measures in the trailing four quarters
publisher: MAS / MND / MOF / HDB (curated from official releases)
definition: Tightening rounds minus easing rounds of residential property measures (stamp duties, loan-to-value and debt-servicing limits, loan tenure, interest-rate floors, eligibility rules) announced in the latest four quarters. A round is one official announcement, however many instruments it changed.
update_frequency: Irregular; hand-maintained from official announcements (review date recorded in the list)

label: URA Private Residential Rental Index (all residential, whole island)
definition: The all-residential slice of the URA rental index file. The file is updated every quarter but this slice stops at 2021-Q2, so staleness must be judged per series, not per dataset.

label: Outstanding housing loans for owner-occupied property (data.gov.sg)
definition: Utilised housing loans for owner-occupied property. The dataset's metadata was touched in 2024 but its data stop at 2015-Q3, so staleness must be judged from observations, not from the update stamp.

label: Non-resident population declared in thousands (deliberate unit error)
definition: The same series as nonresident_population, declared with the unit the first version of this registry wrongly used. SingStat publishes persons (uoM "Number"); the contract check must reject this entry.
